title: HelperSSHConnectionsResult
description: Result of the ssh service's connections op: every connection this helper holds for the coordinator that asked, and the subscription that keeps it current (nocx-oalo1.6.2; design §5.10, scenario 7). A coordinator that restarted rebuilds what it keeps per connection — the far helper's entry, the host's mode, the person's consent — from this answer, and it has to include the connections NO PANE rides: a tunnel, a probe lease, the far helper's own lane. The old per-destination subscription could never show it those, because nothing had named their destinations on the new connection. The array is never null: an empty table is [], because a decoder distinguishing 'this helper holds nothing' from 'no answer' needs the empty case to arrive as one, and a coordinator that read a missing list as 'nothing' would rebuild nothing and never notice.

connections.description: One entry per connection the helper's supervisor table holds, in a stable order (by connection id), so two answers to the same question are the same document.

items.description: One connection: the observation the event stream carries, plus the two facts a restart cannot do without. The observation is the SAME declaration `ssh.connection-state` makes, by $ref and not by a copy, so a receiver folds a list entry and a live event with one function (AD-8).

destination.description: The RESOLVED destination this connection was acquired for, exactly as the op that acquired it carried it. It is what a restarted coordinator redials from, and it cannot be re-derived: the connection id is a digest over the account, the credential principal and the route, and a digest is not a destination. Absent only for a connection this helper never acquired for a destination it was told — one named by a reconnect before anything dialled.

hostKeyFingerprint.description: The SHA256 fingerprint of the host key the connection's CURRENT link was verified against. The host's mode and the person's consent are both keyed by it (ADR-0034, ADR-727g63tr), so a coordinator that restarted cannot rebuild an entry without it. Absent while this helper holds no link for the connection: a fingerprint is what a handshake established, and a supervisor that lost its transport must not go on vouching for one.
